cards.card_text: And they've got a saying: "…The city is the cooking pot, and we are the meat." Twenty-five men at one gate with a SLOGAN, friend, and I've been trying to come up with one for my bakery since the day I got here and I've still got NOTHING.
cards.verse_text: They are saying, ‘Is not the time near to build houses? The city is the cooking pot, and we are the meat.’
